data.explanation: This is an invoice from a carpentry firm for a custom oak built-in shelf and its installation. The total is €1,487.50, made up of €1,250.00 net plus 19% VAT (Umsatzsteuer). Transfer the full amount to the IBAN on the invoice, quoting the invoice number, by the deadline shown. The letter states no consequences for late payment, but late payment could lead to reminders or fees. Keep the invoice, because labour costs for work on your home may be tax-deductible.
data.tax_note: Labour costs for craftsman work in your own home (here installation, €380 net) may be deductible as a household-related service (§ 35a EStG) if paid by bank transfer.
